title: Doorway / Threshold Ownership Transfer
observed_structure: one participant controls access to a bounded space
crossing changes who may remain, speak, or act
the threshold retains evidence of prior ownership after control changes
cinematic_affordances: door held, released, or closed by a different agent
final blocking places the former gatekeeper outside
cultural_scope: general spatial operation; project-specific social rules must define what access means
transferable_structure: control of a threshold changes hands and materially alters who can enter, remain, or act
non_transferable_surface: ritual gates, sacred portals, or culturally specific thresholds used without provenance
